title: SkillForge Academy v2.0.0-beta.1 release preparation and publication gates

preflight.note: Stamped by `repopact new`; the work item was recorded before implementation began.

acceptance_criteria.text: Approve the v2.0.0-beta.1 version lineage and release semantics while preserving published history and confirming all VERSION, RELEASE_LABEL, package, Cargo, Tauri, diagnostics, and installer identity surfaces agree.
Build and identify a release candidate from a clean, known commit; retain its exact Windows artifact, provenance, SHA-256, build evidence, and accurate draft/prerelease metadata.
Pass required automated checks and independent Windows CI for the exact candidate; document any CI billing or signing blocker without weakening gates.

Complete isolated fresh-install and upgrade acceptance on the exact candidate, including preservation of legacy A+ learner state, current progress, backup import/export recovery, package schema compatibility, and Tauri installer identity behavior.
Review privacy, security, accessibility, proprietary-content boundaries, diagnostics, and known functional gaps; publish accurate release notes and limitations.
Obtain required technical and governance authorization; publish or tag only after every release gate passes and the maintainer explicitly authorizes publication.
